decision.observation: 10 mph, gear 1, one light-blue dot lit (in water). The car sits on the right edge of the lane beside a pine trunk, having drifted right; the posted tarmac sweeps left ahead and up past red-roofed buildings at the top of frame.
decision.hypothesis: The car is rolling fast enough to steer. A short throttle-left hold should bring it back to lane centre away from the right-hand pines, aligning with the leftward sweep of the road.
decision.memory: Plain W brought 1 mph to 10 mph and the +5s icon cleared. The lane right of centre here is flanked by pines that would pin the front-right corner.
